about_the_game:
Welcome to Billy the Hero, a thrilling 2D turn-based RPG set on Paradise Island, a once-idyllic paradise now transformed into a treacherous domain following a catastrophic explosion. You will take on the role of Billy, a large bear who awakens with no memory of his past, ready to forge a new destiny.

In this adventure, your mission is to reclaim the island and turn it into your own personal paradise. As you explore, you'll encounter mutated humanoid creatures that you can recruit for your party, each with their own unique abilities and backstories.

But beware! The island is fraught with perilous traps that can result in instant defeat, including deceptive chests and misleading signs that lead you astray. Deceptive characters roam the island, some of whom may trick you with their lies, challenging your judgment and strategy.

Embark on a journey of survival, mystery, and the pursuit of relationships as you confront the dangers of Paradise Island. Will you be able to navigate through the myriad of traps and uncover the truth about yourself and the island?

Join Billy on this unforgettable journey filled with challenges, exploration, and excitement in Billy the Hero!

content_descriptors.notes:
Billy the Hero focuses on relationship dynamics among characters, featuring romantic themes throughout the gameplay. While the game does include some sexy imagery, it does not present explicit nudity or graphic sexual content. Any suggestive visuals are tasteful and ensure no breasts or genitalia are shown.

In terms of violence, players will encounter instances where Billy may die in dramatic ways, such as being impaled by spikes from traps, which may depict graphic imagery of the character’s body being pierced. However, it’s important to note that the game does not involve drug use; Billy does not engage in substance abuse.

We advise potential players to consider their comfort levels with these themes before engaging with the game.
